title: Phase 6 Final Integration, Scientific Integrity & Demonstration Readiness Audit

reconciliation_of_counts.reconciliation_narrative: The dataset manifest indexes 663 files across 6 split sources (362 curated + 301 in data/uploads/). In Phase 3, 621 image files were cataloged (362 curated + 259 uploads). During subsequent integration and API test executions, 42 duplicate test-generated uploads were deposited into data/uploads/. Critically, across all 663 files, there are EXACTLY 373 unique SHA-256 hashes: 362 unique hashes in the curated splits (train, validation, test, eval_known, eval_ood) and 11 upload-only unique hashes (3 genuine macroscopic user field photos: Bituminous Coal, Manganese, Rock; plus 8 test fixtures consisting of corrupt byte files and solid monochrome blocks). The 8 overlapping hashes represent automated API tests that re-uploaded curated test images to the endpoint. No new physical mineral specimens have been added, and zero unverified uploads exist in the training split.

VALIDATED_ACTIVE.actual_semantics: Indicates geographic model availability and training footprint coverage (Sentinel-2 Tile T44QMK Balaghat corridor). Confirms model file exists and is active for spatial inference.
VALIDATED_ACTIVE.misleading_interpretation_prevented: Does NOT claim calibrated commercial deposit discovery or economic certainty. Confidence score is explicitly withheld (None) and accompanied by an uncalibrated spatial index notice.

PRODUCTION_FORECAST_8402.value: 8,402.90 tonnes predicted (2,597.10 tonnes shortfall = 23.6%, HIGH risk)
PRODUCTION_FORECAST_8402.actual_semantics: An operational pit logistics simulation predicting monthly extraction shortfalls from telemetry (equipment downtime, monsoon rainfall, blasting delays) in established Balaghat mines.
PRODUCTION_FORECAST_8402.isolation: Completely isolated from spatial mineral discovery. Exposes its own endpoint (/production-forecast) and dedicated modal (ProductionForecastModal.jsx). For non-manganese commodities, it honestly returns UNAVAILABLE.

SOFTWARE_TEST_VS_SCIENTIFIC_VALIDATION.distinction: 100% software test pass rate proves architectural integrity, crash-free execution, and schema compliance. It does NOT constitute scientific validation of exploration accuracy on unseen global basins or uncalibrated field rock photography.

underground_coal_seams.rule: Optical sensors observe only top surface layer; subsurface seams require drill cores.

iron_ore_surface_staining.rule: Surface ferric iron index (B04/B02) reflects weathering rinds/gossans, not confirmed commercial BIF/BHQ ore.

bauxite_duricrust_distinction.rule: SWIR clay indices detect aluminous laterite/kaolinite, not commercial gibbsitic bauxite without XRD/XRF assays.

manganese_footprint_confinement.rule: Random Forest model operates exclusively within Tile T44QMK; outside coordinates return OUTSIDE_TRAINING_FOOTPRINT with score withheld.

uncalibrated_probabilities.rule: confidence_score is None; predictions are reported strictly as relative spatial prospectivity indices.

ood_rejection_safety.rule: Specimen classifier rejects out-of-distribution rocks (distance > 5.0) regardless of raw softmax probabilities.

missing_satellite_credentials.rule: Missing CDSE credentials produce honest warning messages rather than fabricated live scenes.

truthful_3d_terrain_fallback.rule: 3D terrain outside validated footprint renders true topographic elevation with [OUTSIDE_TRAINING_FOOTPRINT] banner, suppressing fake mineral draping.

python_pytest_suite.environment_limitations: 1 test skipped due to external CDSE live network auth requirement (intentional offline-resilient test).

severity_ranked_defects.title: Manganese ML model restricted to Sentinel-2 Tile T44QMK
severity_ranked_defects.evidence: Analyzing Bangalore or Jharia for Manganese returns model_coverage='OUTSIDE_TRAINING_FOOTPRINT' and prediction=None.
severity_ranked_defects.scientific_significance: Intended behavior to prevent spatial extrapolation to unstudied geologic provinces.

severity_ranked_defects.title: Coal, Iron Ore, and Bauxite operate in evidence-only baseline mode
severity_ranked_defects.evidence: Selecting Coal, Iron Ore, or Bauxite returns model_coverage='NO_MODEL_FOR_COMMODITY'.
severity_ranked_defects.scientific_significance: Truthful representation. Prevents fabricating unvalidated ML predictions.

severity_ranked_defects.title: Production CNN rejects real-world field photographs due to synthetic domain shift
severity_ranked_defects.evidence: Disputed Bituminous Coal upload yields feature distance 11.81 (OOD threshold = 5.0).
severity_ranked_defects.scientific_significance: Synthetic patch training requires lab-certified field rocks for real-world specimen classification.

severity_ranked_defects.title: Copernicus CDSE live token acquisition requires valid subscriber credentials in .env
severity_ranked_defects.evidence: Without .env credentials, CDSE queries fail authentication and fall back gracefully to local archive mode.
severity_ranked_defects.scientific_significance: Truthful failure reporting without fabricating satellite observations.

severity_ranked_defects.title: Stage 8 pipeline text labeled relative prospectivity as 'Calibrated Index'
severity_ranked_defects.evidence: Line 365 displayed 'Calibrated Index: X%' which conflicted with the uncalibrated nature of the spatial index.
severity_ranked_defects.resolution: Updated to 'Spatial Prospectivity Index: X%' in Phase 6 to maintain strict scientific terminology.

recommended_flow: 1. Select Balaghat (Tile T44QMK) to demonstrate active Manganese spatial prospectivity with 8-stage pipeline.
2. Select Noamundi or Jharia to demonstrate truthful evidence-only mode and domain disclaimers (Coal/Iron Ore).
3. Toggle between 10 km, 25 km, and 50 km exploration radii with dynamic survey area calculation.
4. Demonstrate 2D GIS multi-spectral band switching and 3D terrain elevation fallback.
5. Upload synthetic Coal test image (accepted) followed by field photo / quartz (rejected with distance diagnostics).
6. Open Operational Telemetry Modal to demonstrate pit shortfall forecasting without conflating it with mineral discovery.

software_readiness.metrics: 625/626 automated tests passed (1 skipped), 0 build errors, robust error handling.

scientific_field_readiness.status: NOT READY FOR UNMONITORED FIELD DEPLOYMENT
scientific_field_readiness.rationale: Commercial deployment requires physical drill-hole assays, multi-district spatial training, and lab-certified field specimen libraries.
